The sweep over the real tree stays green under it, because the tree is clean -- which is why the guard carries hand-written fixtures that are NOT derived from MAY_IMPORT. 6 of 84 in dependency-direction.test.ts: `flags render -> game`, `flags side-effect import`, `flags CommonJS require`, `flags import.meta.glob reaching another layer` and `flags a directory-index import of game` (all five plant a render -> game import, in a different syntax each, and are now reported clean) and `has a hand-written fixture on both sides of every layer pair` (a 16th allowed pair with no clean fixture and a forbidden one). The other 20 forbidden-pair fixtures pass, as they must -- the mutation opens one direction, not all of them.
